entities.name: A0T0B3 uS14c
observations: Exact 100-aa sequence match to reviewed Phaeodactylum tricornutum plastid small ribosomal subunit protein uS14c (UniProt A0T0B3).
Reference annotation: binds 16S rRNA and is required for assembly of 30S particles; plastid/chloroplast localization.
Sequence-derived estimates: 11,944.082 Da, pI 11.1, GRAVY -0.888, predicted charge at pH 7 +20.742.
